annotation.evidence_span: TCP MUST ask the IP layer to select a local IP address
annotation.interpretation_a: The TCP stack immediately requests an IP address upon connection initiation, even if one is already available or preferred.
annotation.interpretation_b: The TCP stack only requests an IP address if it determines that no suitable local IP address is currently known or configured, potentially deferring the request until a later stage.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'ask the IP layer to select' is incomplete. It doesn't specify *when* the TCP stack should ask. Does it ask every time, or only when it doesn't have a suitable address? This missing condition creates ambiguity in implementation.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify the conditions under which the TCP stack should request an IP address. It's unclear if the request is unconditional or contingent on the availability of a suitable local IP address.
